text:
maya: Need a quick decision: GA offer for reserved capacity — do we include a 10m burst window by default or keep burst an add-on?

 diego: My vote = default small burst (10m at 3x) with opt-out. Sales needs something to promise for pilots.

 tara: Ops: we can do 10m token-bucket escrow per month. Implementation effort low. Need to define preemption order and telemetry.

 infra-bot: runtime-checklist: token-bucket admission, per-tenant ledger, preemption-signal, telemetry hooks.

 legal: if burst is default we must add exhaustion and buyback language. Prefer add-on but can sign default if clear exhaustion behavior.

 maya: Proposal: GA = reserved baseline + 10m burst at 3x, shared pools with escrow, soft-cost-cap 2x monthly spend, hard throttle after cap. Pilot customers can request isolated micro-pools as paid upgrade.

 diego: +1. Add console prompt when a burst would exceed soft cap. Also alert sales at 75% consumption.

 tara: I'll open tickets for token-bucket, preempt order, and telemetry. QA: synthetic 5x 15m test required.

 maya: Decision logged. Action items: tara + diego to spec config by EOD, legal to draft clause. Reconvene after tickets land. :thumbsup:
